_comment: Site-specific settings ONLY. The licence and the author list are NOT stored here — they are read at build time from the package repository, so this site cannot disagree with the package. See `source` below. Everything under `fallback` is used only if those reads fail.

source._licence_from: DESCRIPTION -> License: field. Authoritative for CRAN and Bioconductor, so relicencing the package updates this site with no edit here.
source._people_from: CITATION.cff -> authors. Already governs how the work is cited, so credit here cannot drift from credit in the literature.

_roles_note: CITATION.cff carries names and ORCIDs but has no role vocabulary. Entries here add role, since/until, and current/emeritus status, matched by exact name. A person in CITATION.cff with no entry here appears as 'Contributor'. Set `include_if_absent: true` for someone who should be credited but is not a package author — an infrastructure or site maintainer, say. Setting `current: false` moves them to a PREVIOUSLY section rather than deleting them; attribution should not vanish when someone leaves.

fallback._note: Used only if the package repository cannot be read. Keep roughly current so a network failure does not publish something badly wrong.
fallback.acknowledgement: mixOmics has been developed since 2009 by Kim-Anh Lê Cao, by developers engaged and trained through her research funding, and by contributors across the community. See CITATION.cff in the package repository for the full author list.
